entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Ou pap janm ka konprann." t="You will never understand." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Ou pap janm ka konprann." t="Nu o să înțelegi niciodată." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Diferans ant ou menm avè m se nan kote nou prale a ak nan jan nou fè l la." t="The difference between you and me is both our destination and our approach." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Diferans ant ou menm avè m se nan kote nou prale a ak nan jan nou fè l la." t="Diferența dintre tine și mine e atât destinația, cât și abordarea." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Se pa wout ou sa." t="This is not your road." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Se pa wout ou sa." t="Nu e drumul tău." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Non! Ou pa kapab! " t="No! You cannot!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Non! Ou pa kapab! " t="Nu! Nu poți!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Sa pa nesesè!" t="This is unnecessary!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Sa pa nesesè!" t="Nu e nevoie de asta!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Ou vle goumen?" t="Do you wish to fight?" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Ou vle goumen?" t="Vrei să te bați?" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Mande tèt ou si se sa ou vle tout bon vre." t="Ask yourself if this is what you really want." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Mande tèt ou si se sa ou vle tout bon vre." t="Întreabă-te dacă asta chiar vrei." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Talè pap gen mwayen fè bak." t="Soon there will be no turning back." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Talè pap gen mwayen fè bak." t="Curând n-o să mai fie cale de întoarcere." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Mwen toujou pa renmen w, pou tout bon." t="I still really don't like you." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Mwen toujou pa renmen w, pou tout bon." t="Tot nu-mi placi, pe bune." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Mwen rayi ti koken kou wè w." t="I hate smartasses like you." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Mwen rayi ti koken kou wè w." t="Urăsc deștepții ca tine." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Hey… Sa sa a ye?" t="Hey… what's this?" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Hey… Sa sa a ye?" t="Hei… ce-i asta?" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Sa a pa bon." t="That's not right." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Sa a pa bon." t="Nu e în regulă." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Tout bagay an fòm." t="Everything in order." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Tout bagay an fòm." t="Totul în ordine." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Tout bagay sou kontwòl." t="Everything's in control." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Tout bagay sou kontwòl." t="Totul e sub control." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Mwen konnen ou la, mwen konnen map jwenn ou." t="I know you're here and I know I will find you." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Mwen konnen ou la, mwen konnen map jwenn ou." t="Știu că ești aici și știu că te găsesc." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Ou mèt vini… Mwen pap fè w anyen." t="Come on… I won't hurt you." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Ou mèt vini… Mwen pap fè w anyen." t="Hai… nu-ți fac nimic." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Li mouri!" t="Dead!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Li mouri!" t="Mort!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Oh, wi tout bon." t="Oh, sure." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Oh, wi tout bon." t="Da, sigur." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Ou fè yon gwo erè!" t="You have made a fatal mistake!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Ou fè yon gwo erè!" t="Ai făcut o greșeală fatală!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Pap rete yon zo w pou fè bouton!" t="There will be nothing left of you!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Pap rete yon zo w pou fè bouton!" t="N-o să mai rămână nimic din tine!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Mwen voye yon grenad!" t="Grenade out!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Mwen voye yon grenad!" t="Granată!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Mete kran! San Pitye!" t="Be determined! Be ruthless!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Mete kran! San Pitye!" t="Fii hotărât! Fii nemilos!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Annavan, louvri sou yo!" t="Spread out!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Annavan, louvri sou yo!" t="Răspândiți-vă!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Kou langèèèt!" t="Holy shit!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Kou langèèèt!" t="Ce dracu'!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Sa pa bon menm, menm, menm!" t="Bad, bad, bad!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Sa pa bon menm, menm, menm!" t="Rău, rău, rău!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Kalma, kalma." t="Calm down." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Kalma, kalma." t="Calmează-te." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="¨Pouki tout prese sa a?" t="What's the hurry?" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="¨Pouki tout prese sa a?" t="Ce te grăbești?" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Alo." t="Hey." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Alo." t="Hei." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Bon… Sa w panse…? Non … pa gen chans…Ki mele fif mwen..." t="Uh… welll… What did you think…? No… no chance in hell… I don’t give a shit…" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Bon… Sa w panse…? Non … pa gen chans…Ki mele fif mwen..." t="Ăă… păi… Ce credeai…? Nu… nicio șansă… Mă doare-n cur…" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Kote w jwenn mesye…? Lwen konsa…? Fòk ou verifye si mesye pa sou kontwòl nèg Netwatch yo…" t="Where did you find him…? That deep…? You need to check him for Netwatch influence…" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Kote w jwenn mesye…? Lwen konsa…? Fòk ou verifye si mesye pa sou kontwòl nèg Netwatch yo…" t="Unde l-ai găsit…? Așa de adânc…? Trebuie să verifici dacă nu e sub controlul NetWatch…" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Pran yo sou kote! Sou kote! Sou kote!" t="Flank! Flank! Flank!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Pran yo sou kote! Sou kote! Sou kote!" t="Flanc! Flanc! Flanc!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Nou la!" t="Ten four!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Nou la!" t="Primit!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Atensyon, grenaaad!" t="Careful! It's a grenade!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Atensyon, grenaaad!" t="Atenție! Granată!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Babay." t="Bye." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Babay." t="Pa." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Gen yon bagay ki dwòl." t="Something doesn't add up." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Gen yon bagay ki dwòl." t="Ceva nu se leagă." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Di mwen! Nou pa ka fè kòm si nou pa wè sa a." t="C'mon! We can't just let that slide." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Di mwen! Nou pa ka fè kòm si nou pa wè sa a." t="Hai! Nu putem lăsa asta baltă." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Fout tonnè! Pare tèt nou!" t="Oh fuck! Get ready!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Fout tonnè! Pare tèt nou!" t="Futu-i! Pregătiți-vă!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Pa rete kanpe la a! Bat dèyè nou! " t="Don't just stand there, go!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Pa rete kanpe la a! Bat dèyè nou! " t="Nu stați așa! Mișcați!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="An nou goumen!" t="Let's fight!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="An nou goumen!" t="Hai să ne batem!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Khh… ackk… fout… lach" t="Khh… ackk… fucking… coward." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Khh… ackk… fout… lach" t="Khh… ackk… lașul dracului." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Non, kenbe li pou kounye a … Mm… Li ka vin bon pou nou." t="No, keep him for now… Mm… Might come in handy." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Non, kenbe li pou kounye a … Mm… Li ka vin bon pou nou." t="Nu, ține-l deocamdată… Mm… Poate ne folosește." b="" a=""/>
